mapper.select: SELECT tool_name AS toolName, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, ROUND(AVG(cost_ms), 1) AS avgMs, MIN(cost_ms) AS minMs, MAX(cost_ms) AS maxMs FROM tool_call_log WHERE create_time >= #{from} GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total DESC
